title: City of Streator cancels November 11 plan commission meeting
text:
City of Streator cancels November 11 plan commission meeting
The City of Streator has cancelled its November 11 Plan Commission meeting. The session was scheduled for City Hall. Future meeting dates will be announced by city officials.
The regular meeting of the City of Streator Plan Commission scheduled for November 11 at 6:00 p.m. has been cancelled. The meeting was to be held at City Hall, 204 S. Bloomington Street, in the City Chambers in Streator, Illinois.
Patricia L. Henderson, Executive Assistant to the City Manager and City Clerk, announced the cancellation. No reason for the cancellation was provided in the notice.
The City of Streator Plan Commission typically meets to discuss planning and zoning matters affecting the community. These meetings are open to the public and are held at City Hall.
Municipal operations in Illinois are subject to various state regulations and financial considerations. In the fiscal year of 2025, expenditures by the state of Illinois included over $14.4 billion in the General Revenue fund and nearly $3.9 billion in the Common School fund, among other allocations, according to the Illinois Comptroller's Office.
Future meetings of the City of Streator Plan Commission will be announced as scheduled. Residents seeking information about upcoming meetings or city planning matters are encouraged to contact City Hall.
